messages:
sam: Anyone up for a co-op night this Friday? Thinking Monster Hunter Rise on Switch or Helldivers 2 on PC. I can bring my Switch + MH cartridge, but need extra controllers/dock. :joystick:

nina: I'm in for MH. Can bring a Pro Controller and some spare Joy-Cons. What time? :thumbsup:

alex: Helldivers 2 noise here — will probably be messier but fun. I can host on my PC if we have 4 people. :exploding_head:

harry: Friday evening works. 7pm? Also, is there a TV/dock in the office we can borrow?

sam: 7pm works. Does the office have a dock + HDMI cable in storage? ops-bot do we still have the equipment locker open after hours?

ops-bot: Reminder: equipment-bunker is bookable until 21:00. Please return gear the same night. (auto-message)

maria: I can bring an HDMI cable and a powered USB-C hub. Also happy to bring pizza if folks chip in $5 each. :pizza:

nina: pizza = yes. Also quick poll: Reply with emoji for what you prefer:
• :one: Monster Hunter Rise (Switch)
• :two: Helldivers 2 (PC)

alex: :two: Helldivers 2 (but will also play MH if needed)

harry: :one: MH. Prefer couch co-op vibes.

sam: :one: MH (switch + pro controller incoming)

maria: :one: MH — pizza + hunting sounds perfect

ops-bot: Booking confirmed: equipment-bunker reserved Fri 19:00-21:00 for #random thread 1745002468.

alex: Also if anyone needs a controller adapter for PC I have a USB adapter. Happy to bring.

nina: Bringing extra Joy-Cons in case. Sam — do you have a dock or should I bring my travel dock?

sam: I don't have a dock small enough for travel, so please bring yours if possible. thanks!

harry: I'll bring a blanket and some controllers. Can someone DM me $5 for pizza?

maria: DM sent. See y'all Friday! :wave:
